rubrics.text: stretching out body after physical exertion
bubble starts from heart and passes through the arteries
fears unless constantly on the move the heart will cease
drops were falling from the heart
fat about the heart with nervous irritability
compelled to lie on the back with head raised
at night when lying on the back amel. by sitting up
as if heart and ovary were drawn together
alternating with pain in great toe
from joint to joint and then locates in
numbness and lameness of left arm
drawing up chest and throwing back right arm
must lie still with closed eyes
from the first movements of the child
slow in during day and evening
slower than the beat of heart
strain of the heart from violent exertion
after entering cool room from a walk in hot sun
